notes.title: v1.5.5 Minor fixes
notes.content:
What’s New
A “Hide Mask” option has been added to the Billboard controls, allowing you to remove the cut corners and have a full rectangular image.

New console commands have been added for more control over video recording output. Both these commands have only been partially tested and are considered Experimental features that may produce unexpected results. ⚠️

setting-videorecording-offline command has been added to the console to enable “Offline Rendering” to achieve smoother video recording at the expense of causing gameplay stutter while recording.

setting-videorecording-fps allows you to change the recording framerate (e.g. 60fps).

setting-videorecording-mbps allows you to set an average and maximum Mbps bitrate for video recording to produce higher quality recordings at the expense of file size.

setting-videorecording-interval allows you to set the keyframe interval for recording to produce higher quality videos in some scenarios.
Bug fixes
Fixed a bug where Lens Dirt style was not saved with photo mode settings

Fixed a visual UI error where some elements were cut off

Fixed a UI scrolling issue with the Mod list

Fixed a bug where Roads and other splined props could have their heights adjusted beyond their set limits.

notes.title: Introducing Mod Support (beta)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/3bb66f68f0b6a1380a8e05f0434e36cf4d54256c.png

After testing our ModKit in the experimental branch for several weeks, we've now enabled Mods in Dystopika's public branch. We are ready to open the floodgates for custom districts, buildings, props, and holograms via Steam Workshop. 

Release Notes v1.3.1
Mod Support (Beta)
Dystopika now supports custom content created with our ModKit. Mods can be distributed via Steam Workshop, or by placing any modification packages into the new Mods folder (see City Save Editor below).

Mod Support is still considered “Beta” and may have unexpected behaviors. We continue to track bugs and improve workflow for the Dystopika ModKit. Please stop by the #dys_modding channel in the Discord to get help or request features.

If you’d like to learn more about making mods for Dystopika, please visit  http://modding.voidswithin.com. We are continuing to add documentation and tutorials. 

City Save Editor
With Mod support, there is a new interface for creating cities that allows for enabling and selecting mods, as well as quick shortcuts to the Steam Workshop and Mods folder.

This same screen allows you to enable/edit mods for old cities, and to quickly access world seeds or rename cities without needing to Load the City. 

Quality of Life

 A duplicate save button has been added to the Load City screen
 An indicator has been added to indicate the currently open city on the Load City screen
 Green “error blocks” will now appear in-game where content has failed to load, e.g. if a mod is missing.
 Added an Intensity slider to Advanced Prop menu for Hologram emitters to control brightness
 Added a “Legacy Screenshot Mode” toggle to use the old screenshot method at the expense of less accurate fog rendering.


Minor Changes

 Various visual improvements to the Load City screen
 Loading up the game will now reload the last opened city (previously opened last SAVED city)
 Experimental Mode notification now only displays in Pause Menu
 Building previews now support multiple materials and meshes in preparation for mod support
 Resolution scale setting is now maxed at 1.5. 
 Made some adjustments to Fog Quality at Ultra quality for better performance.
 Increased the horizontal size of the District selection menu to accommodate longer names.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where some buildings could not be height adjusted.
 Fixed a bug where Props were being improperly positioned near the city border.
 Fixed some visual elements not being included in unlock transitions.
 Fixed some visual effects not triggered on some props and bridges.
 Fixed a bug where widescreen resolution screenshots were being clamped to 4k.
 Fixed a bug where Props unlock progress was not being cleared when resetting the player profile.
 Fixed a bug where changing holograms on an emitter would change the wrong emitter.
 Fixed a bug where "Angled Top" CBD building had a chance of breaking game input.

Release Notes
Quality of Life

 Photo Mode: If the new "Lock" toggle is active, Photo Mode will now retain your previous settings the next time it is opened. This allows you to switch back to build mode without losing your photo mode composition. These settings are also saved whenever the city is saved, so you can easily resume your last photo mode session after closing the game.
 Photo Mode: The Camera Height slider range has been expanded to -6 / +6 for more dramatic angles.
 Photo Mode: Sun Color now applies to both sun and moon objects
 Photo Mode: Taking screenshots at a different resolution than the current game resolution will now take an additional 1-2 seconds, depending on your system, to allow the temporal fog to resolve properly and produce a more accurate image


Bug Fixes

 Fixed some Photo mode settings that would not reset correctly
 Fixed a camera judder when entering Photo mode.
 Fixed a problem where the Sun Color and Intensity sliders would not always apply changes consistently.


Future Photo Mode enhancements
This is the first of several planned enhancements to Photo Mode including camera movement modes, additional settings, and quality of life improvements. Stay tuned!

notes.title: v1.2 Available Now
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/d7adec710a526d7a4ea7ead87b0259d11f2515d1.gif

A final update for 2024 brings a huge visual upgrade to Dystopika's sky, adding dynamic clouds, snowy weather, dynamic time of day, stars, and upgraded fog. 

It's been a wild 6 months since Dystopika 1.0 and I really want to thank everyone who's played the game, left reviews, and joined our community. It's been truly a life-changing experience. 

2025 will continue updates, with the introduction of Mod Support being our top priority. 

Wherever you are in the world, I'm wishing the best to you and yours and see you in 2025! 

v1.2.0 Release Notes

Dynamic Sky and Weather
Sky has been completely overhauled providing dynamic weather and time of day, plus new snow options in the City Settings (just in time for the holidays). 

 Default Time of Day is now “Dynamic”, progressing through a full cycle in approximately 30 minutes.
 Stars are now visible at night (weather allowing).
 Sun and Moon’s tilt, orientation, and size are randomized as part of the city’s World Seed.
 Rain slider in photo mode has been changed to “Weather” and will control cloudiness as well as precipitation.
 Snow accumulates on rooftops when set to Snowstorm. 
 Overall Fog quality has been improved.
 Fog Quality and Dynamic Cloud settings can now be found in the pause menu.
 A Noon option has been added to Time of Day presets


Holiday Lights

 Two new special holiday light fixtures have been added to support the December challenge competitors🫡

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/2e2fa2f8894c8dcc9a6e061e8a82677de9fd2cc3.png

Quality of Life

 Various game loading mechanisms have been completely rebuilt in preparation for mod support. 
 Internal crash reporting has been improved to assist in tracking down some rare crashes
 Fog Intensity and Fog Height setting behavior in Photo Mode have been improved
 All unlocks are now available in Experimental mode


Minor Changes

 Internal Light Streak settings have been adjusted for an improved, cleaner look
 Sun Intensity control in Photo Mode has been refined


Bug Fixes

 Various stutters when placing buildings have been eliminated
 Fixed a floating building in Eden district
 Fixed a bug where the Prop tool is active on game startup


Looking ahead to 2025

notes.title: A Roadmap Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/f19e41fe5a5737ecf584b165a1bc4b4291801eed.gif

Hey everyone! I wanted to share an update to Dystopika's post-launch roadmap. 

Firstly, Mod Support is being prioritized over the planned Photo Mode enhancements. This will be a big project, but I feel will be more exciting for the community. 

There is demand for so many new buildings, props, and districts that it is far bigger than anything I could make on my own, so I want to put that into modders hands as soon as possible. 

Secondly, I'm adjusting the release cadence. Packing many new features developed over several weeks into a single release created a lot of friction in the testing. 

As a result, I've re-organized the roadmap into approximate timelines rather than grouping by version number. I'd like to return to smaller but more frequent, focused updates where small features can ship when they are ready instead of waiting on being bundled with a "big update". 

I'm really excited about these changes and some of the work happening behind-the-scenes right now (like dynamic sky). 

As always, I'm grateful as hell to this community, the things you create, and the kindness you have shown me and each other. 

Let's keep this update train rolling!
Matt

notes.title: Dystopika is 2024's most underrated city builder, and it just got a huge update
notes.content:
What frustrates you the most in Cities Skylines 2? For some players, it's getting taxes absolutely right. In other cases, optimizing garbage collection and building the perfect road network are a constant bane. Obviously you want a challenge in a strategy game, but there's also something to be said for sitting back and just admiring your creation, those reflective moments in Civilization 6 or Age of Empires where you just bask in the majesty of what you've made. Take that feeling and combine it with Night City from Cyberpunk 2077 - eliminate all the headaches from CS2, and indulge, fully, in the joys of architecture and urban design. This is Dystopika, a unique city builder that you have to play, especially now it's had a huge update.

notes.title: v1.1.1 Now Available
notes.content:
Hello again everyone! 

Happy (Canadian) Thanksgiving! A small(ish) update here, primarily aimed at bug fixes and quality of life improvements related to v1.1 feedback. 

Release Notes
Changes

 Norsk language now available
 Fog shadowing has been added to maximize sunset 𝕍𝕀𝔹𝔼𝕊.
 Whale hologram has been recentered to the emitter and motion adjusted for better consistency in preparation for future functionality
 Noto Sans Devanagari and Noto Emoji are now part of the Neon Sign fallback font library. 😈🚀🍕
 Made some adjustments to the rain particle system to improve look and performance
 Pause menu news updates from Steam will now prioritize certain updates
 Adjusted some props to allow for more versatile placement

Quality of Life

 Resolution/Vsync settings have reworked to better demonstrate the functionality relating to framerate
 Fullscreen windowed mode has been added
 Target FPS slider has been added, activated when Vsync is set to off, and also reflects how Vsync limits framerate at different settings
 Closed Loop road setting has been moved to the Advanced Prop panel (no more right click)
 When playing on the Experimental Branch, “Experimental Mode”, will now be visible on the screen. 
 Bulk Backup restore buttons now activate in Experimental mode. 
 Experimental Mode saves are now separate from main branch saves and progress is tracked separately. This prevents accidental corruption of saves when moving back and forth between main and experimental. I continue to stress: THINGS MAY BREAK IN EXPERIMENTAL and your saves may be lost
 Removed achievement progress from Experimental mode
 Increased distance threshold to initiate right click on billboard to change image (prevent accidental clicks) 
 Decreased height of selectable area on roads to make it easier to select curve control points. 

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where Closed Loop roads did not save properly
 Fixed a bug that caused Weather state to not save
 Fixed a bug that caused a break in the Monorail track geometry
 Fixed a bug that caused rain to be more performance intensive that it needed to be. 
 Fixed a bug where traffic density would not update all parts of the road
 Fixed incorrect texture filtering on traffic
 Fixed Vsync count not saving with resolution settings
 Fixed an issue causing stuttering when rendering UI with Thai characters
 Fixed an issue where buildings could not be moved if placed inside a Prop

Known Issues

 Display settings may need to be reset to reflect new modes and values
 Display settings only show available resolutions and refresh rate for current mode. Options may change when switching between Display Modes (e.g. Fullscreen to Windowed) 
 Some prop placements generate incorrect rotations

What's Next
The Roadmap is currently being adjusted to prioritize the introduction of Mod Support before Photo Mode improvements along with other community suggestions. Stay tuned.

notes.title: Dystopika v1.1 now available
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The wait is over and I'm happy to unleash Dystopika 1.1. This update ended up having much more than originally planned and I'm excited to see what you will create.

For a quick rundown of the new features, I'd like to turn things over to DeLindsay Gaming, who compiled this excellent overview during the update's private beta phase alongside his usual work unlocking the extraordinary things that can be done with Dystopika. 

[previewyoutube=6DcTlB_i7fk;full][/previewyoutube]

What's Next
The next update, v1.2, is dedicated to Photo Mode and improving not only how you capture your creations but also bringing several photo mode settings into your city settings for a whole slew of new city-building vibes.

Expect new tools for plotting camera movements, improved camera controls, being able to save presets, and likely a few more surprises. 

I'm also looking ahead to 1.3 where I will start unlocking modding possibilities. 

Release Notes

What's New
Highways & Monorails
There are three types of new Transportation-themed props: Small Roads, Wide Roads, and Monorails. These props are controllable curves that can be placed anywhere on the map and height adjusted with five control points. 

When close to the ground, these new types will clear away any low-lying density to prevent awkward building collisions. 

New Buildings & Props
6 new buildings (with 2 height variants) have been added to the existing districts. New props include the aforementioned Transportation paths as well as satellite dishes, mounted signs, and more. 

While this is a small content update for buildings, there have been significant changes to props to set better foundations for future mod support, primarily in the form of...

Advanced Prop Controls
Props now have a series of advanced controls to modify size, rotation, and other settings based on the specific prop. Press TAB to bring up the Advanced Controls panel to explore what you can do. 

See Quality of Life updates for what's new with existing props. 

New Languages
French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Thai, Indonesian, and Russian has been added to the game. 

Achievements are now translated as well. 

I am also now opening up our translation project on CrowdIn to the public to contribute to additional languages or improve the existing translations. Join our Discord to learn more about contributing in the #dys_translations channel.

Quality of Life
Updated Clone Tool
This was a secret debug tool which has now been polished and improved.

Before moving a building hold ALT to clone the highlighted building. Any attached props will be cloned as well. 

Control Tips
To better expose the Clone Tool above and other more secretive power tools (like Light Brush size), there are now context-aware control tips in the lower left. They can be disabled in the settings. 

Unified Billboards
Billboards are now represented just by their aspect ratio in the Prop menu, and can be resized with Advanced Controls (TAB) to be tiny or massive. 

The Custom Media button has also been relocated to the Advanced Controls menu where there is also a HEX colour and brightness control. 

Billboards from your old saves should still work, but there may be slight color/brightness shifts due to the new color and brightness controls.

Unified Text Tool
Similar to Unified Billboards, the Text props have been unified to a single prop with Advanced Controls (TAB) to set size, orientation, and colour. 

Air Traffic Control
In City Settings you can now control how much Air Traffic your city has - or turn it off completely. 

Other Changes

 Removed Unity splash screen
 Removed Grid Snapping toggle. Replaced by the control tips but buildings can still be snapped with CTRL.
 Steam News now displays in the Pause Menu
 Load City screen will now show the current city in the list of save files and a non-interactable item
 Safe Mode now has a persistent UI reminder


Bug Fixes

 Save Files are written to a temp file first to prevent loss of save due to a crash
 Additional Memory optimizations have been made to the Undo/Redo stack
 Improved some prop positioning constraint logic
 Fixed several non game-breaking writable geometry/collision errors
 Fixed a bug where deprecated props were accessible in the random prop selector. 
 Tooltips now forced to stay on the screen
 Fixed a bug where some operations would be cancelled when mouse is hovered on the Toolbar
 Fixed a bug where tutorials and progress could not be saved.
 Prevented ENTER from spawning UI element duplicates
 Fixed some rotation errors related to prop placement

notes.title: An Update on 1.1
notes.content:
Hello friends, I may have cooked too much. 

1.1 has become bigger than I had originally planned and it needs just a little more time to simmer. 

However, I think you will be very happy with the expanded 1.1 update which now includes new content on top of the planned Quality of Life updates for billboards, custom neons, flying traffic, and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/00b518d63144511909b49c6e47f3462df163344e.gif

Highways
The Discord Road Warriors have been heard loud and clear and highways are coming to Dystopika 1.1. Highways can be adjusted to create the bends and curves your dystopian heart desires. You can make roads span the full city or make them weave and duck through each other like a giant web. They are also height-adjustable to make skyways or some Rollercoaster Tycoon-inspired insanity. You can also adjust traffic density and there will be multiple road styles. 

New Buildings and Props
Each district is getting new building types alongside several new props. New creative possibilities! More teases of the new content over the coming weeks. 

Community Creation Challenges
The mod team will be rolling out regular timed theme creation challenge to spark your imagination and creativity. We'll be highlighting the best of the best on various social channels. 

Community Translation Project
1.1 will be including more language options but we will also be opening up the translations to allow for anyone to contribute new languages and suggest changes - with the goal of being able to continuously translate and improve the localization as new features are added. 

Coming Late September
Thank you for your patience, I hope the wait will be worth it. 

I'm not ready to set the exact date yet, but anticipate 1.1 to release during the second half of September.

notes.title: Dystopika v1.0.5 now available
notes.content:
Hello everyone. There will be some news on 1.1 coming soon but in the meantime, I'm happy to release v1.0.5 which introduces Safe Mode as well as some under-the-hood changes to how saves are handled that will benefit those who play Dystopika across multiple devices.

Yes, I skipped v1.0.4. I attended the Microsoft Windows School of Counting. 

Release Notes - v1.0.5

What's New
Safe Mode

Safe Mode will skip loading custom billboard media (and show a broken image in its place). The custom media is still "linked" and will reappear the next time you open outside safe mode, but with Safe Mode you can remove or replace billboards if you exceed your system memory. In short, you can attempt to bring a city back under memory requirements in the event of a crash. 

Safe Mode also disables Save on Exit and adds a warning when you are about to save.

Safe Mode also exposes Bulk City Import and Export options in the Pause Menu, which allows you to backup all of your cities and import accordingly. Great for when you want to hop onto the experimental branch without affecting your saves.

To enter Safe Mode, press F8 during the intro message, or use the console command safe-mode.

Quality of Life

 If Custom Media billboard cannot be found, it will display a blue Broken Image billboard instead of a random billboard which was the old behaviour. The path to the media will be retained unless the billboard is manually changed or deleted. This is helpful if you use a Steam Deck and don’t want to break your saves that use Custom Media (which doesn’t move with your city). 
 Last Opened City is now saved LOCALLY and will not be synced. This prevents unintentionally opening a city on another device (like a Steam Deck) which may not be desired.


Bug Fixes

 Prop placement having unexpected results when placed on buildings near the world border (i.e. strange rotation behaviour)
 Fixed a bug that prevented prop unlocks from saving.
 Fixed some bugs that would prevent the game from soft locking due to loading corrupted saves.


A Note on Translations
Some newer features, buttons, and modals are missing edge case translations and will default back to English right now. There is a larger translation project happening behind-the-scenes where I am changing the workflow to make it easier to continuously improve translations as I add features. Stay tuned.

notes.title: Dystopika v1.0.1 now available
notes.content:
Wow. Just wow. 

Thank you so much for your reviews, your kindness, your Tweets, and enjoying this weird little thing I made. It's unexpected, it's overwhelming, it's amazing. I love this freaky little project and I can't wait to realize some wild places I want to take it. 

I tried to address some of the most immediately actionable feedback and bugs in a quick week one update. I hope this improves your experience of Dystopika. 

Release Notes - v1.0.1

Quality of Life Improvements
Game Console
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/f44f951bc815a8003e84e53696cc06e78a362b93.png

Introducing the Game Console! It can be accessed by pressing the ~ key (or whatever is left of the 1 on your keyboard layout).

Currently it is limited to just a few commands but I will be adding more over time.

I wanted to introduce a console to not only improve my ability to fix bugs, but also to provide faster iteration on fixing reported problems before doing a full UI integration. Here's some of the first commands. 

deck - A quick macro command to force 1280x800 fullscreen on the SteamDeck in case you get locked out of the UI, which may encounter some unsupported scenarios. 

music-next - skips to the next track (on shuffle)

setting-vsync - force a vsync count (0,1,2,3,4). 0 is Vsync off

setting-targetfps - target framerate when Vsync is 0

setting-resolution - force a specific resolution and view mode

The game console is EXPERIMENTAL and recommended only if you're experiencing an issue with the game. 

Experimental Branch
There is now an Experimental Branch for early access to bug fixes. Please drop by #dys_experimental in the Discord to be notified of updates. 

New Settings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/7db3dd85ae6d62615f454ee2cf7af88f4f44f340.png
Lens Dirt On/Off
Disabled Bloom Lens Dirt in build mode (can still be added in Photo Mode)

Blur on Zoom On/Off
Disabled Blur effect when the camera is zoomed in and out. 

Vsync replaces Target FPS
The Vsync option should better allow you to target a framerate to prevent GPU overheating. 

 Off = unlocked FPS
 Refresh Rate = target your resolution's refresh rate
 1 / 2 = target HALF your resolution's refresh rate
 1 / 3 = target 1/3 your resolution's refresh rate 
 1 / 4 = target 1/4 your resolution's refresh rate


If you'd like to know more of the technicals, you check out the Unity docs

Bug Fixes

 Prop unlocks now persist across cities properly. 
 Billboards now have improved transparency handling for custom import images
 Target FPS has been replaced by a VSYNC option to potentially aid with spicy GPUs. 
 Certain holograms and achievements have been made less RNG-dependent. 
 Some tracklist adjustments have been made to Foundations soundtrack.
 Vertical Neon Text props now handle line breaks in the right direction
 Fixed a bug when the game would Save twice when clicking Quick Save
 The Ad Blimp now initializes random ads from the default ad pool
 Edit Text/Prop highlights should no longer get stuck when entering and exiting text editing. 


Known Issues

 At low framerates, building movement has difficulty registering
 Importing the same image to different billboard sizes may result in rotated billboards
 Using CTRL to snap can sometimes become inverted with the UI control
 Light Brush neons sometimes do not save properly
 Some new Translations might be... off. I am currently working on a new solution for Localizations for better workflow as we get ready to expand to new languages.

notes.title: Dystopika 1.0 arrives June 21
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Iw1_i1bHkYI;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello friends! As you may have heard from the Future Games Show Summer Showcase: Dystopika is releasing one week from today on June 21! Sure there's some -other- DLC releasing that day, but Dystopika is here for your relaxing interludes of creativity and meditation. 

It's been quite a ride these past few months. Over 40,000 demo downloads and 800+ on the Discord sharing their creations, inspirations, and suggestions. As a solo developer, it's been amazing to log in every day and see others fired up about the game and doing amazing things.

Final Demo Weekend starts now
Originally, the demo was intended for a limited time during January and February, but the feedback, suggestions, and creations have been so outstanding that I kept it going - almost like an "open Beta" for the past few months.

So the time has come. it's time to put it to bed and move on to the full game. The demo will be discontinued and disabled on Steam on Monday, June 17. 

Demo saves
Demo saves should open normally in the full game, but may look slightly different due to new content and features. 

Post-launch Roadmap Coming
Dystopika 1.0 is just the departure point. This is an ongoing passion project for me and there will be a roadmap of what the future looks like available at launch. 

Thanks for playing and creating, and I'll see you on the other side.

notes.title: 日本語 / 한국어 | Demo v0.8.5 released
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for a tremendous Endless Replayability Fest!

Demo v0.8.5 (05/22/2024)

Translations

 Japanese (日本語) has been added to the demo
 Korean (한국어) has been added to the demo
 Some bugs with Chinese translations (简体中文 / 繁體中文) have been addressed


Quality of Life Improvements

 Using right click to cycle to another tile will now progress in sequence, making it easier to find specific tiles. 
 A small settings screen opens the first time the demo is played for setting Language and Music Volume
 A small cursor appears when the camera is moving to better illustrate the focal point
 An automatic migration will check your My Documents/Dystopika for save files and move them to a new Location in LocalLow/Voids Within/Dystopika (see below)
 Added more placement flexibility to billboards and neon signage. 


Bug Fixes

 Refresh rate now shows properly in the resolution settings
 Fixed some prop placement geometry for some buildings
 Fixed some crashes on startup when system language matches a possible, but disabled translation in the game. 


Save Files
Due to reported issues with Steam Cloud syncing saves from My Documents/Dystopika, I've decided to move save files to the easier-to-work-with AppData/LocalLow. This prevents potential conflicts with OneDrive syncs or general permissions problems within My Documents.

A migration (mentioned above) will move any existing Saves to the new locations and rename the old folders as Backups. If you encounter no issues, the Backups can be safely deleted.

Steam Cloud will be turned on again soon to support the new file location. 

My Documents will still be used for Screenshots and ImportAds.


 C:/%USERNAME/AppData/LocalLow/Voids Within/Dystopika//etc is where Cities, City Thumbnails, and overall Game Progression is now saved
 My Documents/Dystopika is where you will continue to find screenshots, and a folder for importing custom images due to easy access. These folders are not synced to Steam Cloud. 


Thank you for your patience while I worked out a few of these kinks with the Save system.

 Pressing F3 will hide the UI until F3 is pressed again OR the menu is accessed 
 Photo Mode now has a tool to create moving drone shots to assist with video capture with external tools (e.g. OBS)
 Photo Mode screenshot button will now take an HD screenshot at double the current resolution up to 4K, pending future setting to control output screenshot resolutions. This allows ultrawide screenshots as well. 
 Added a Rain Intensity slider to Photo Mode. 


Bug fixes

 Added a Loading check to ensure successful startup before proceeding to load game assets. Should help prevent crashes on some systems where Unity's audio system needs some extra startup time (i.e. bluetooth headphones)
 Fixed a bug where rapid Undo/Redo would break construction animations
 Fixed a bug where spamming Delete tool would cause game breaking issues. 
 Tile rotation tool now always anchored on the tile's midpoint regardless of height

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo | Update 0.5.4 released
notes.content:
In order to better facilitate more time to tweak and augment your dystopian creations, the 15 minute demo time limit has been removed. Enjoy unlimited time in meditative melancholy as you build your vision of the future. 

0.5.4 is now live with these changes. 

Continue to share your cities and feedback over in the Discord - I love to see it all (good and bad) and I've been overjoyed by the response to Dystopika.

Demo 0.5.4 (02/06/2024)

Content
- Increased chances for Skywhales and Airships.

Quality of Life Improvements
- Demo time is now unlimited

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo | Update 0.5.3 released
notes.content:
Dystopika is part of the February Steam Next Fest. During the event, you can play the new updated Demo! You’ll find airships, holographic whales, and more environmental cyberpunk eye candies. All to make your escape to a future that you’ve built all that more pleasing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/f030b7eac24a3c549d5512f1e7c60d60bc92605c.gif

Enjoy your time in Dystopika and do share your cities either here on Steam, on socials, or on Discord. If you have any feedback for me, leave it in the Steam forums or in the official Dystopika Discord server.

If you played the demo and liked the experience, add Dystopika to your Wishlist on Steam. It’ll mean the world.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379910/Dystopika/

Enjoy the Demo. Until next time,

Matt || Voids Within

0.5.3 Demo Release Notes (2024-02-06)

Content
- Airships, Sky Whales, and other special holographics will spawn under certain conditions
- More billboard graphic variety
- New Ground Tile type to indicate where new holographics will spawn

Quality of Life Improvements
- Added Brightness slider to Settings screen
- Right Controller stick will now rotate camera (but other controller support work still ongoing)
- Added some Readme information to help keen Dystopika mod explorers. 

Bug fixes
- Spacebar no longer triggers screenshots when writing feedback in Photo Mode
- Rain now tracks camera position properly and is more prominent
- Fixed blend mode for some particle systems
- Small red line appearing on some low-lying buildings removed
- Minor geometry and texture tweaks on some ground tile buildings. 
- Fixed some non-critical construction animation failures
- Fixed a bug that allowed buildings to be moved outside the boundary when snapped

Performance
- Made some adjustments to draw call batching - hoping to see performance improvements in some areas.
